fields.quoted_span:
It is unlawful for a landlord to use an algorithmic device to set rental rates or
                            occupancy levels for residential rental property.
fields.note: Sale/license ban, use ban, definition, per-month/per-property violations, tenant remedies, fee recovery, cumulative remedies and City enforcement all appear in §§ 98.1102-98.1104.

fields.quoted_span:
A tenant may seek injunctive relief, damages, or civil penalties of up to
                      $1,000 per violation of this Division
fields.note: Penalty cap, separate violations, fee recovery, City civil and criminal enforcement, and effective 6-21-2025 are all stated.
Enacted 5-22-2025, effective 6-21-2025. The 30-days-after-final-passage formula is not in this document, but the dates match.
The code (6-2025 edition) shows the division as added and effective, so in_force is consistent. No repeal or sunset appears.

fields.quoted_span:
It is unlawful for a person to sell, license, or otherwise provide an algorithmic
                            device to a landlord.
fields.note: Applies to residential rental property in the City of San Diego, to sellers/licensors and landlords. No unit, date or owner limits are stated. The 'Residential rental property' meaning is cross-referenced to § 98.0702, not set out here, so the quoted definition text is not in this document.

fields.quoted_span: §98.1103             Use and Sale of Algorithmic Devices Prohibited
fields.note: §§ 98.1101-98.1104, O-21955 N.S., and the division title appear in the text. The O-2025-107 alias is not in this document.
